---
title: "Reference"
---

Generated from the package docstrings.

````{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import inspect

import xvrt

def render(obj, name):
    sig = str(inspect.signature(obj)).replace(", *,", ",\n    *,")
    print(f"## `{name}`\n")
    print("```python")
    print(f"{name}{sig}")
    print("```\n")
    doc = inspect.getdoc(obj) or ""
    # numpydoc sections -> bold labels; parameter names -> code
    out, section = [], None
    for line in doc.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped and set(stripped) == {"-"}:
            continue
        if stripped in ("Parameters", "Returns", "Raises", "Notes", "Examples"):
            section = stripped
            out.append(f"\n**{stripped}**\n")
            continue
        if section in ("Parameters", "Raises") and line and not line.startswith(" "):
            out.append(f"\n`{stripped}`\n:   ")
            continue
        out.append(stripped if section in ("Parameters", "Raises") else line)
    print("\n".join(out).replace("\n:   \n", "\n:   "))
    print()

for name in ("write_mdim_vrt", "from_stac", "encode_datetime_coord"):
    render(getattr(xvrt, name), name)

print("## `VrtWriterError`\n")
print(inspect.getdoc(xvrt.VrtWriterError))
print()
print("## Accessor\n")
print("`import xvrt.accessor` registers `Dataset.vrt.write_mdim(path, sources=..., ...)`, "
      "which forwards its arguments to `write_mdim_vrt`.")
````
